observations.statement: Games on Poki earn only through in-game ads served by the Poki SDK, with no in-app purchases and no third-party ad systems.
observations.excerpt: Games on Poki earn through in-game ads, served entirely by the Poki SDK. There are no in-app purchases and no third-party ad systems to integrate.

observations.statement: Poki supports midroll ads signalled by commercialBreak(), with Poki deciding when an ad is actually shown.
observations.excerpt: Midroll ads run at natural breaks in the session: between levels, after a game over, when leaving a pause. Your game signals opportunities with commercialBreak() ; Poki's system decides when a player is actually ready to see one, so not every call shows an ad.

observations.statement: Poki supports player-initiated rewarded videos triggered with rewardedBreak(), which must never block core gameplay.
observations.excerpt: Rewarded videos are the player's choice: watch an ad, get an in-game benefit. Your game triggers them with rewardedBreak() on an explicit player action. Rewarded content is always an optional extra and never blocks core gameplay.

observations.statement: Games supporting portrait mode become eligible for Gamebar Display ads, a mobile title-bar format.
observations.excerpt: Games that support portrait mode also become eligible for Gamebar Display ads , a mobile format in the title bar that earns extra without any work from you.
